newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada dlr closes stronger after volatile day.
newsitem.headline: Canada dlr closes stronger after volatile day.

text.p: * Canada's dollar ended a roller coaster day on Tuesday to close stronger at C$1.3634 (US$0.7335) from Monday's close oft C$1.3669 (US$0.7316) in moderate trading, dealers said.
* The market weakened sharply overnight on year-end demand for U.S. dollars, but buying by Canadian corporations throughout the day strengthened the Canadian currency.
"As soon as we opened, Corporate Canada sold (U.S.) dollars," said Reid Farrill, foreign exchange specialist at CIBC Wood Gundy.
"The long positions were shook out of the market."
The U.S. Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady also encouraged the Canadian currency market, dealers said.
"I think Canada's got a little bit of momentum," added Farrill.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar rose to 1.1364 marks from Monday's 1.1297 marks and to 83.48 yen from 83.23 yen.
